title: The Word Transformation Machine
description:
In the city of Numera, a mysterious text machine receives a collection of words and transforms some of them before printing the final result.

The machine follows a hidden rule. By observing the sample cases, determine how the machine transforms each word.

Your task is to reproduce the output produced by the machine for every given word.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer N, representing the number of words.
Each of the following N lines contains one word consisting only of lowercase English letters.
output_format:
Print N lines.
The i-th line should contain the transformed form of the i-th word.
